-- coding.helper.enforce_quota
-- Protocol-7 module for enforcing per-job byte quotas

local module = {}

-- Configuration lookup
local config = require("system.config")
local quota = config:get("coding.helper.enforce_quota", "quota", 4096)

-- In-memory usage tracker keyed by job_id
local usage_tracker = {}

-- Logging facility
local log = require("system.logger")

module.name = "coding.helper.enforce_quota"

--- Enforce the byte quota for a given job.
-- @param job_id string - The unique identifier for the job
-- @param bytes_used number - The cumulative bytes used by the job
-- @return boolean - TRUE if within quota, FALSE if exceeded
function module.enforce(job_id, bytes_used)
    if not job_id or not bytes_used then
        log.warn("enforce_quota called with invalid arguments: job_id=%s bytes_used=%s",
                 job_id, bytes_used)
        return false
    end

    -- Initialize usage for this job if not already tracked
    if not usage_tracker[job_id] then
        usage_tracker[job_id] = 0
    end

    -- Update the cumulative usage
    usage_tracker[job_id] = usage_tracker[job_id] + bytes_used

    -- Check against quota
    if usage_tracker[job_id] > quota then
        log.warn(
            "Job '%s' exceeded byte quota: used %d bytes (quota: %d bytes)",
            job_id,
            usage_tracker[job_id],
            quota
        )
        return false
    end

    return true
end

--- Reset usage for a job (useful for test cleanup).
-- @param job_id string
function module.reset(job_id)
    usage_tracker[job_id] = 0
end

--- Get current usage for a job.
-- @param job_id string
-- @return number
function module.get_usage(job_id)
    return usage_tracker[job_id] or 0
end

--- Get the configured quota.
-- @return number
function module.get_quota()
    return quota
end

return module
